subsystems.name: NPU core
subsystems.role: performs the matrix and tensor arithmetic that dominates neural-network inference.
parts: MAC arrays for low-precision math (INT8, INT4)

subsystems.name: Host CPU and GPU
subsystems.role: run the operating system, orchestrate tasks and handle any model layers the NPU cannot.

subsystems.name: Memory subsystem
subsystems.role: feeds the accelerators with model weights and activations fast enough to keep them busy.

subsystems.name: Software stack
subsystems.role: turns trained models into instructions the NPU understands.
parts: frameworks and APIs (e.g. ONNX, DirectML, Core ML)

subsystems.name: Thermal and power management
subsystems.role: keeps the chip within its power and temperature budget in a thin laptop.

subsystems.name: Model storage and loading
subsystems.role: stores compressed models and loads them securely on demand.

buildSteps.title: Design the SoC
buildSteps.detail: Architects define the NPU block, its instruction set and its connection to CPU, GPU and memory, then write and verify the register-transfer-level design.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate the silicon
buildSteps.detail: The design is taped out to a foundry and built on an advanced process node, where billions of transistors are patterned layer by layer on a silicon wafer.

buildSteps.title: Package and test the chip
buildSteps.detail: The die is cut, bonded into a package with memory and power delivery, and tested for defects before shipment.

buildSteps.title: Build the mainboard
buildSteps.detail: The packaged SoC is soldered onto a printed circuit board alongside memory, storage, power regulators and connectors.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the laptop
buildSteps.detail: The board, battery, display, keyboard and cooling system are fitted into the chassis and tested for fit and function.

buildSteps.title: Enable the software
buildSteps.detail: Drivers, compilers and OS integrations are written so that mainstream AI frameworks can target the NPU; models are quantized to low precision to fit.

buildSteps.title: Validate performance and power
buildSteps.detail: Engineers run inference benchmarks, measure battery life and thermal behaviour, and verify that AI features work reliably across applications.

buildSteps.title: Flash, certify and ship
buildSteps.detail: Final firmware and operating system images are installed, the device is certified for sale, and it is packed for distribution.

prerequisites.why: NPUs only make sense when millions of arithmetic units can be built cheaply on a small, low-power die.
neural networks tolerate 8-bit and 4-bit math, which is far more energy-efficient than floating point.
large models must be shrunk to fit in laptop memory and run within a battery budget.
compilers and runtimes map model graphs onto NPU hardware without hand-tuning each model.
inference is often memory-bound, so feeding the NPU is as important as the math itself.

pathway.milestone: NPUs of tens of TOPS in mainstream laptops, used for background blur, transcription and photo editing
pathway.unlocks: always-on AI features that run locally without sending data to the cloud.

pathway.milestone: NPUs approaching 100 TOPS and unified memory architectures
pathway.unlocks: running small and medium language models entirely on the device.

pathway.milestone: co-processing between NPU, GPU and CPU for mixed workloads
pathway.unlocks: faster, more flexible local assistants that combine vision, speech and text.

pathway.milestone: on-device personal agents with persistent memory and privacy
pathway.unlocks: AI that learns from your data without it ever leaving the laptop.
